absolute-resonance:

Unfortunately, Li Luo was born with an incredibly rare condition known as a blank resonance - as the name suggests, he doesn't have one! Normally, this would be utterly crippling, but at least he has the advantage of being the young master of the mighty House Loulan, one of the five Great Houses of Xia. Unfortunately, his parents, the powerful masters of House Loulan, have gone missing for many years, and the other Great Houses are beginning to eye their holdings quite hungrily. For that matter, plenty are also eyeing his talented, beautiful childhood friend and fiancee Jiang Qing'e, who has been leading House Loulan in his parents' stead! Li Luo would much rather keep a low profile and wants call off the engagement - but Jiang Qing'e has flatly refused. What's a 'useless young master' to do?
Is there any way he can get out of this engagement? Can he figure out a way to protect his House from the jackals circling around it? And... is a blank resonance really useless?
Come and find out!

playboy-cultivator-in-the-apocalypse:
Dual cultivation and apocalypse—words that mix like oil and water. There's nothing charming about seducing feral women on the road.

But chains don’t just bind the body. They shape the soul. And Amari’s soul is beginning to stir.
With nothing but grit, loyalty, and a defiant heart, he walks the line between myth and mortality, hunted by secrets older than the stars. In a tale of betrayal, survival, and the quiet power of choice, Ragnarök, Eternal Tragedy asks: Can a boy without magic rewrite the fate of gods?

Kage was born a talentless bastard into the mighty Ironstorm Clan. Cast aside for his worthlessness, he was abandoned in a fortress reserved only for failures.
Despite the sting of being branded a Talentless Bastard, Kage found contentment with his mother, his loyal servant Taro, and Shinro—his one-armed, fallen Purist guardian.
But the fragile thread tethering him to happiness severed on his eighteenth birthday when assassins murdered them all. Though powerless, Kage devoted his entire life to pursuing vengeance.
And vengeance wielded by a boy with nothing left to lose became the ultimate weapon that brought a mighty clan crashing to ruin.
Yet at his death, Kage discovered his entire crusade for revenge had been misdirected—aimed at the wrong target.
Fortune smiled upon him as he gained the power to return to the past. But not alone.
Kage emerges in the past alongside twelve Sovereign Gods who had each, in their era, ruled the world as peerless Purists and Weavers.

Every corpse pays out stats. Every monster makes him permanently stronger.
In one night he goes from unranked to E-rank, leaving questions behind him... a faceless woman who saved his life, a hero already pulling his file, and whoever forced that gate open on purpose.
The ladder above him runs seventeen ranks, and every step costs more than the last.
Fin's system doesn't care what things cost.

Hugo was a college student known for his intelligence and handsome looks. Being ranked as the number 1 student in the most renowned school on earth, there was no doubt that many people were envious of him. The only problem was, he was from a poor family.
When everything went downhill, and their family fell into a huge debt, he had no choice but to look for several ways just to earn a huge sum of money. That’s when an unknown man offered him $600,000 just to join a secret experiment being held by the government.

On the day of his judgment, Hugo accidentally found a hidden door in heaven. That’s where he met Goddess Thalia, who was known to be the kindest goddess that ever lived on the planet earth.

Saying 5000 year-old-dragon has an impressive ring to it, yet that dragon was an extremely harmless, herbivorous being. However, because of his uselessly giant figure and scary appearance, he was mistaken for the Demon King’s executive and provided by the nearby village with a sacrificial maiden.

However, Damon Valentine had no plans of letting his little mate go. Captured, Harper was brought back to Damon’s pack― not as his future Luna, but as his pack’s newest slave.

Mara and Maria-Isabel have always been best friends. But while Mara is happily married to Ethan, Maria-Isabel is trapped in an abusive relationship. When Mara and Ethan help her escape, they never expect what happens next.

Gray Starlight is the youngest son of Seraphina Starlight, the powerful Matriarch of one of humanity’s greatest families in a world where danger lurks around every corne.
Few months after his seventh birthday, memories from a previous life awaken within him. Along with them comes a shocking realization—this world is the very novel he once read.

He is merely an extra, an insignificant character whose existence was never meant to matter.
Unlike everyone else, Gray possesses fragments of the future. He knows of the disasters that will one day threaten humanity, the rise of powerful individuals, and the tragedies waiting to unfold.
Yet he has no intention of following the story.
He refuses to become part of someone else’s destiny.
He doesn’t seek glory.
He doesn’t dream of becoming a hero.
His only wish is to live peacefully with the family he never had in his previous life and protect the people he has come to cherish.

Alien races threaten humanity’s very existence. Monsters roam the land.…

She handed her father the research that made him a national celebrity.
She gave her eldest brother a patent worth millions.
She created the formula that built her second brother's empire.
She turned her third brother into a medical prodigy.
In return, she received her parents' disdain, her brothers' hatred, and was even locked in the basement until her death.
Only then did she learn the truth: she was never a Sterling at all. Just a swapped-in nobody, raised as a stepping stone for their real daughter.
Reborn, she gives up on pleasing anyone and leaves the entire family to Stella.
Her eldest brother's company has a critical materials defect? She sells the fix to his biggest rival.
Her second brother's wine business? She opens her own and takes every client.
Her third brother's medical career? She walks his path first and leaves nothing behind.
One by one, the Sterlings crumble.
Now they're at her door, tears streaming, dragging their precious Stella out onto the street — anything to bring Josephine back.
Too late.
